defects.what: entry is posted without checking that total debit equals total credit
reversal copies debit/credit instead of swapping them, so it doubles the original
posting into a closed accounting period is not prevented (periods.is_closed never called)
revaluation uses the document-date rate instead of the period-end (closing) rate, so the difference is always zero
sign is not inverted for payables: a rate increase is a loss on AP but is reported as a gain
credit note increases the receivable instead of reducing it
load grows 25 % per week for every level including beginners (far above the ~10 % rule), and sessions also go up every week to 7 with no rest day
red-flag symptoms (chest pain, dizziness) are ignored: training continues and even increases instead of stopping and referring to a doctor
Mifflin-St Jeor sex constants are swapped (+5 is male, -161 is female)
fixed 1000 kcal deficit with no floor can drop small users below a safe intake (e.g. under 1200 kcal)
0.8 g/kg protein (sedentary RDA) is too low for training users, especially in a deficit or for gain (1.6-2.2 g/kg)
24/7 crypto annualised with sqrt(252) trading days instead of sqrt(365)
shuffled K-fold on time-ordered data with 24-bar forward labels leaks the future (needs purged/embargoed walk-forward)
contract_size is ignored, so the position is off by the contract multiplier
